'''Mua Niab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] technician living during the [[Galactic War]], who did not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was called to repair a mobility-impaired droid [[AV-9R]] on the [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mua Niab appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a companion of the Operation courier for the "Explosive Conflict" operation. Originally present on the Carrick Station, he was moved to [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']] with Update 4.0.
